title: Petroleum tanker drivers' peaceful protest/industrial action over depot roads
location: Tema/TOR and roads to depots; exact assembly location unknown
organizer: Ghana National Petroleum Tanker Drivers Union
threshold_50_evidence: Unknown; none of three reviewed bodies gives a simultaneous crowd estimate or establishes an assembly form. The ministry's later label 'peaceful protest' does not prove 50+ participants.

occurrence.summary: Graphic/GNA document sit-down strike and ministry mediation; later ministry report calls it a peaceful protest but does not establish a public gathering. Public-action form remains unresolved.

date.summary: Start June 26; suspension on third day per retrospective ministry report. Approximate end June 28.

location.summary: Tema/TOR/Kpone road network; no gathering location documented.

organizer.summary: Ghana National Petroleum Tanker Drivers Union.

attendance.summary: Unknown; no count, and cannot be inferred from workforce or membership.

demands.summary: Road repairs; union says action sought road repair and requested adequate funds/logistics.

state_target.summary: Roads Minister and ministry action are directly addressed; demand concerns public road infrastructure.

state_response.summary: Minister intervened and promised road repairs, while GNA reports indoor meetings; categorical state_response fields remain unknown absent incident-specific evidence for the codebook dimensions.

protester_violence.summary: Minister says peaceful protest/no violent demonstration; no other violence evidence.

continuity.summary: Strike began June 26 and suspended on third day per retrospective ministry report; GNA June 29 says strike suspended following meetings. Do not infer separate demonstrations.

limit_note: Supersedes the categorical exclusion X001 only as a disposition because new retrospective ministry evidence describes a peaceful protest. Does not verify public gathering form or threshold; original exclusion is preserved for history.
notes: A later Ministry report labels the union action a peaceful protest, but does not establish a public gathering or attendance. Candidate remains pending_evidence and no threshold is presumed.
